title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - Size
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/Size . The amount of certain objects in a collection (e.g. the size of a material batch). Subclass of the external saref:Property class (SAREF core, not redefined in this ontology file). The SAREF4INMA ttl does not itself declare a data property on Size; `value` and `unitCode` are included here, following the generic SAREF Property/Measurement value pattern, so that a Size instance is actually usable as the target of a Batch's hasSize relationship.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Size'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

value.description: Property. Not a literal OWL data property of s4inma:Size in the ttl; added for usability so the quantity a Size represents can be expressed. The numeric amount of objects in the collection.

unitCode.description: Property. Not a literal OWL data property of s4inma:Size in the ttl; added for usability. The unit in which `value` is expressed (e.g. 'C62' UN/CEFACT code for 'one'/piece).
